subject: Possible duplicate renewal charge
description: A workspace owner reports two charges for the same renewal period and asks what will happen next.

subject: Refund request after recent purchase
description: A customer asks whether a subscription purchased 12 days ago is eligible for review.

subject: Billing history question
description: A workspace owner wants help locating the date and plan name for a charge.

subject: Password reset message expired
description: A customer says the recovery message is older than 30 minutes and can no longer be used.

subject: Lost access to recovery address
description: A customer cannot access the verified recovery address and requests an address change.

subject: Multi-factor device replaced
description: A customer has no recovery code after replacing a multi-factor device.

subject: Request to upgrade workspace
description: A workspace owner wants to move from Starter to Team during the current billing period.

subject: Downgrade timing
description: A workspace owner asks when a downgrade will take effect and what should be adjusted first.

subject: Cancellation and continued access
description: A customer cancelled renewal and asks whether access ends immediately.

subject: Integration shows AUTH-401
description: A connected service stopped syncing after authorization was revoked.

subject: Repeated RATE-429 errors
description: A workspace sees rate-limit errors during a large synchronization operation.

subject: Provider timeout
description: A connector returns SYNC-504 for one operation and then succeeds on retry.

subject: Unfamiliar sign-in reported
description: A customer reports a sign-in they do not recognize and asks what to do next.

subject: Request to disable verification
description: A customer asks support to bypass an integration security check temporarily.

subject: Audit event retention question
description: A workspace owner asks how long security and administrative audit events remain available.

subject: Search results are slow
description: A support agent reports that workspace search takes longer than usual for a small query.

subject: Dashboard does not refresh
description: A user sees older ticket information after returning to the dashboard.

subject: Workspace access after cancellation
description: A customer cancelled renewal and wants to confirm the paid-period access behavior.

subject: Refund request outside standard window
description: A customer asks about a refund 45 days after an initial purchase.

subject: Review active sessions
description: A customer completed recovery and asks how to review sessions after a suspicious sign-in.
